name: tenko-frontend
description: Tenko (点呼) screen client. BUILD-time only: Node is never needed to run Tenko (ADR-020 point 2). The build output ui/static/app.js + ui/static/app.css is tracked in git and shipped. Kedua skrip build di bawah HARUS sama persis dengan resep `make frontend` di Makefile: `--legal-comments=eof` + banner Lenis (lisensi GSAP/MIT menuntut notisnya ikut terkirim) dan `--external:` untuk aset yang dilayani runtime, bukan dibundel.

scripts.build:js: esbuild frontend/src/main.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=es2020 --charset=utf8 --legal-comments=eof --banner:js='/*! Lenis 1.1.0 — The MIT License — Copyright (c) 2024 darkroom.engineering — https://github.com/darkroomengineering/lenis/blob/main/LICENSE */' --outfile=ui/static/app.js
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:js && npm run build:css
